extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Factors — a factor divides a number exactly with no remainder. Factor pairs: 1x12=12, 2x6=12, 3x4=12. Factors of 12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. (2) Multiples — a multiple is what you get by multiplying a number. Multiples of 5: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. Every number is a multiple of itself and 1. (3) Prime and composite — prime: exactly two factors (1 and itself). 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 are prime. 2 is the smallest and only even prime. Composite: more than two factors. 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12 are composite. 1 is neither prime nor composite. (4) Divisibility tests — by 2: last digit is 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8 (even). by 3: sum of digits divisible by 3. by 4: last two digits divisible by 4. by 5: last digit is 0 or 5. by 9: sum of digits divisible by 9. by 10: last digit is 0. (5) Prime factorisation — break a number into prime factors using a factor tree. 12 = 2 x 2 x 3. 18 = 2 x 3 x 3. Start with smallest prime, keep dividing. (6) HCF — highest common factor = largest number that divides both. HCF of 12 and 18: factors of 12 are 1,2,3,4,6,12; factors of 18 are 1,2,3,6,9,18; common are 1,2,3,6; HCF = 6. (7) LCM — lowest common multiple = smallest number that both divide into. LCM of 4 and 6: multiples of 4 are 4,8,12,16,20; multiples of 6 are 6,12,18; common is 12; LCM = 12. Misconceptions: '1 is a prime number' (1 is NEITHER prime nor composite — it has only one factor, not two), 'all even numbers are composite' (2 is even AND prime — it is the only even prime), 'factors are always smaller than the number' (the number itself is always a factor — e.g., 12 is a factor of 12), 'HCF and LCM are the same' (HCF finds the LARGEST common FACTOR, LCM finds the SMALLEST common MULTIPLE — they are different concepts), 'a number divisible by 3 is always divisible by 9' (9 is divisible by 3 but not all multiples of 3 are multiples of 9 — e.g., 12 is divisible by 3 but not by 9). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function FactorsMultiplesGame), NOT export default. Export interface FactorsMultiplesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
